Job Title: Software Engineer, Full-Time Position

Employment Type: Full-time
Working Hours: 38 hours per week

result.description:
The Role

We are hiring a Software Engineer who will single-handedly analyse, design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and document full-stack operational systems serving Chinese clients across semiconductor, MCU, and cross-border business domains. This is not a narrowly scoped position — the successful candidate must independently manage the complete lifecycle of multiple concurrent software systems, from requirements gathering with Mandarin-speaking stakeholders through to production deployment on China-compliant infrastructure.

The role requires a rare combination of full-stack software engineering, hands-on Linux server administration, working familiarity with IC design and EDA tool environments, and the ability to operate fluently in both English and Mandarin Chinese across technical, business, and compliance contexts. The candidate will be the primary technical owner of all systems and must be capable of working without supervision across all layers of the stack and across all stages of delivery.

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and document full-stack web applications end-to-end — including React or Vue front-end interfaces, Python-based backend services, relational databases, RESTful APIs, authentication systems, and administrative dashboards — within a single-engineer ownership model.
- Build and maintain internal tools, management systems, workflow dashboards, and client-facing operational platforms for cross-border Chinese SMEs, semiconductor companies, and engineering teams, including direct integration with Chinese digital platforms (WeChat ecosystem, Alipay, China-specific cloud APIs) using Chinese-language API documentation.
- Develop and maintain software tools, scripts, and workflow automation systems that support IC design operations, including DFT workflows, Verilog-based digital logic design, verification pipelines, and EDA tool environments (Cadence and Synopsys) — covering environment configuration, licence server management, and build-flow automation.
- Deploy, configure, monitor, and maintain applications on Linux-based server environments across Mainland China and international infrastructure, including ICP-filed domains, China-based hosting, cross-border DNS and CDN configuration, reverse proxy setup (Nginx), and environment-specific application configuration. Troubleshoot infrastructure issues specific to China-facing deployments, including Great Firewall constraints and dual-environment architectures.
- Identify technology limitations, performance bottlenecks, and process gaps across existing systems, then independently design, implement, and document improvements — maintaining technical documentation, API references, deployment runbooks, and operational procedures in both English and Chinese.
- Analyse operational metrics, system performance data, user feedback, and error reports to drive continuous improvement across all systems under management.
- Serve as the primary technical point of contact for bilingual teams, Chinese clients, and stakeholders across China, Hong Kong, Singapore, and Australia, conducting requirements gathering and technical communication in both English and Mandarin Chinese.

Technical Requirements

Required

- Hands-on experience in full-stack web development, with demonstrated ability to independently deliver complete systems from front-end to backend to deployment.
- Strong proficiency in Python as a primary backend language, with production experience in Django, Flask, or FastAPI for building database-backed web applications and API services.
- Production experience developing front-end interfaces using React or Vue (not merely prototyping), including state management, component architecture, API integration, and responsive design.
- Demonstrated experience building and maintaining internal tools, admin panels, operational dashboards, and workflow management platforms for business users.
- Solid understanding of RESTful API design, relational database modelling (PostgreSQL or MySQL), authentication and authorisation systems, third-party API integration, and system-to-system communication patterns.
- Hands-on Linux server administration experience, including setup, configuration, application deployment, Nginx reverse proxy configuration, SSL/TLS management, firewall rules, log management, cron jobs, process supervision, and production troubleshooting — not merely development on Linux.
- Practical experience with Docker containerisation, CI/CD pipeline configuration, and cloud or hybrid server deployment environments.
- Working knowledge of digital IC design workflows, including an understanding of DFT (Design for Test) concepts, Verilog HDL, digital logic design, synthesis, and verification processes — sufficient to develop, configure, and maintain software tools and workflow integrations that support IC design engineering teams.
- Direct experience working with EDA tool environments, specifically Cadence and/or Synopsys toolchains, including at least one of: tool installation and environment configuration, licence server setup and management, build-flow scripting and automation, or integration of EDA tools into broader engineering workflow platforms.
- Familiarity with ARM Cortex and/or RISC-V processor architectures and MCU-based development workflows, with sufficient understanding to build and maintain software systems that support semiconductor engineering and production operations.
- Demonstrated experience with Mainland China infrastructure and compliance requirements, including ICP filing processes, China-based hosting configuration, China-accessible domain and DNS setup, and deployment of applications that function reliably behind the Great Firewall.
- Experience building operational software systems for Chinese businesses, including direct integration with Chinese digital platforms, services, or APIs (e.g., WeChat ecosystem, Alipay, China-based cloud providers), with the ability to independently read and implement from Chinese-language technical documentation.

Preferred

- Experience developing automation scripts, engineering workflow tools, internal development platforms, or integration layers specifically for semiconductor or IC design teams in China.
- Understanding of MCU, semiconductor, embedded systems, or IC design industries in Greater China and broader Asia, particularly where software platforms support engineering, production, or client delivery workflows.
- Experience with software performance optimisation, security hardening, monitoring and alerting systems, and deployment automation for production environments operating across multiple jurisdictions.
- Familiarity with cross-border data handling, dual-environment deployment architectures (China/international), and the operational constraints of running software services that must function in both mainland Chinese and international network environments simultaneously.
- Experience working in small teams or as a sole technical operator with full ownership of systems from requirements through to production support.

Language & Communication

- Proficient in English.
- Fluent Mandarin Chinese, both spoken and written, is required.
- Ability to communicate technical requirements, system issues, software specifications, and deployment matters with Chinese clients and Mandarin-speaking stakeholders.
- Ability to read and interpret Chinese platform documentation, API documentation, compliance materials, and technical communication; draft technical communications in Chinese for mainland stakeholders; and navigate Chinese-language developer resources, forums, and support channels without assistance.

result.description:
At City Beach, our people are at the core of what we do, both our customers and our team. All are welcome under the City Beach roof, where value is placed on individual style, teamwork, authenticity, adaptability, and a desire to exceed expectations. 

We stock some of the world's biggest brands across surf, skate, streetwear, and fashion. Our stores are a hub that connect our customers to events, influencers, and trends, allowing them to live life on their terms. 

The role:
As a Software Developer and Database Administrator for City Beach, you will be responsible for designing, configuring, maintaining and supporting applications and database platforms and related data services to ensure data integrity, security, backup, reliability and performance. The role also supports internal reporting and analytics solutions by ensuring data structures, SQL queries, integrations and documentation are accurate, secure and maintainable. This is a full-time position working an average of 38 hours per week based in Brisbane, Queensland.  

Key Responsibilities:
Design, configure, maintain and support database management systems, database architecture, schemas, tables, data structures, data dictionaries and naming conventions to ensure data accuracy and completeness. 
Design, develop, test, deploy and maintain internal software applications and tools. 
Implement, administer and monitor database security, access controls, data integrity controls, backup processes, recovery procedures and disaster recovery planning. 
Perform operational and preventative maintenance for database environments, including scheduled backups, recovery testing, patching, capacity checks and routine health monitoring. 
Write, maintain and optimise SQL queries, stored procedures, views, data extracts, transformations and data models to support reporting, analytics, integrations and operational decision-making. 
Investigate, troubleshoot and resolve database issues, application data issues, performance concerns, failed jobs, data quality exceptions and other incidents affecting business systems whilst encompassing workstations and communication infrastructure.   
Test database systems and upgrades by debugging, tracking, reproducing, logging and resolving issues in accordance with approved testing scripts, procedures and quality processes. 
Prepare and maintain database documentation, including data models, data dictionaries, standards, operational procedures, security guidelines, recovery instructions and system logs. 
Monitor database, application and infrastructure performance to ensure system components operate reliably together, and recommend enhancements to improve availability, scalability, security and performance. 
Develop, maintain and enhance internal reporting solutions and dashboards, including Power BI reports and business performance dashboards, using accurate and governed data sources. 
Collaborate with stakeholders, security vendors, software suppliers and service providers to analyse user, system, database and reporting requirements and deliver practical, secure and maintainable technical solutions. 

About You:
Bachelor’s degree in relevant field or minimum 5 years experience in a similar role
Strong technical knowledge of database administration, database design, data modelling, relational database concepts and data analysis techniques. 
Sound understanding of programming languages such as C#, C++, Python. 
Strong technical knowledge of data models, database design, development, and data analysis techniques 
Proven experience maintaining database environments, including backup and recovery, data integrity controls, performance monitoring, troubleshooting and disaster recovery practices. 
Proficient in writing, maintaining and optimising SQL queries, stored procedures, views, extracts and data transformations. 
Sound understanding of database security principles, access controls, auditability, operational risk and change control processes. 
Experience developing reports, dashboards and data visualisations, including Power BI or similar tools, using accurate and governed data sources. 
Excellent analytical skills with the ability to collect, interpret, and present complex data with accuracy and attention to detail. 

Why Join Us: 
40% team member discount for you, your friends and family to access. 
Access to our Beach Benefits Program where we have partnered with industry leaders to bring our team members discounts on products and memberships to keep you healthy on all fronts. 
Access to Psych Health our Employee Assistance Program. 
Prezzee Gift Cards for major milestones and yearly anniversary celebrations. 
Weekly shared morning tea to celebrate team member milestones. 
Friday 4pm finishes and social drinks every week.? 

Annual income for standard 38 hour week is $85,000 to $95,000 plus superannuation commensurate with industry rate, skills and experience.  

City Beach appreciates the value of a diverse workforce, and we are passionate about actively seeking to accommodate the unique needs of all people. We are committed to building an environment that respects, celebrates, and empowers individual differences. Above all, City Beach aims to ensure everyone is treated with dignity and respect.

Organisation: Dubbo Grain Packing (DGP) 
The address for the position is at: 105 Westbury Rd Trangie NSW 2823 

Grain Handler
Employment Basis: Full-Time
Salary: $90,000

Specific Task
•	Operate specialize Kotzur bulk grain handling circuit to use for the receival, storage, transfer, packing, and dispatch of grain products.
•	Conduct detailed inspection of equipment, check and record any faults and rectified before operation (refer to maintenance schedule procedure).
•	Reference should be given to risk assessment of bucket elevator operation. Paying particular attention to that all safety guards and equipment are installed (refer to risk assessment).
•	Before putting drag conveyor into operation, ensure foreign material is removed from drag conveyor.
•	Ensure close all boots and inspection panels and ensure drive guards are in place.
•	Start conveyor motor and listen carefully if any abnormal noises before operation.
•	Conveyors should not be operated unless they are completely enclosed, and power transmission guards are in place.
•	Follow inspections schedule to ensure the equipment is in good operating condition.
•	Inspect chain, paddles, transmission v-belts.
•	Check chain tension, gearbox, bearing, all sheave drive and attaching parts, check all hardware, and check chain carrier tracks.
•	As per WHS requirements tests E-stops, control panels (refer to risk assessment operation).
•	Once bulk grain handling circuit is safe to operate, proceed to the test running the circuit with no grain.
•	Proceed to control room and test container inverter weight scales are reading correctly.
•	Carry out visual inspection of individual weight scales, frames, wiring are safe to operate.
•	Ensure twist locks on both inverter 1 and 2 are operating correctly.
•	Inspect and grease cylinders, pivot points and check safety guards are operating correctly.
•	Ensure area is clear of any obstacles (shovels, brooms, grains, water, etc) to move any trip hazard while loading.
•	Check fumigation clearance has been approved, and the area is safe.
•	Coordinate with export team members to ensure packing can commence.

General Task
•	Clean, repair as required and inspect containers to meet the standards of food quality of Department of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Forestry.
•	Report of any major faults of containers to site manager, so replace container can be organised.
•	Record individually containers specifications when received.
•	Follow site safety procedures and permit system.
•	Perform routine inspections of plant equipment and report faults, breakdowns, or maintenance requirements.

Requirement: 
•	At least 12 months experience with DND Container Inverters 
•	And 12 months experience with Grainline Bunker Stackers.
•	12 Months experience with KPC Bulk Train Loader

Job description:

Position: Stonemason – Full-Time FIFO

Company: Stellar Contracting Services Pty Ltd

Location: FIFO – Onslow, Western Australia

Employment Type: Full-Time

About Stellar Contracting Services Pty Ltd

Stellar Contracting Services Pty Ltd is a Western Australia-based marble extraction and processing company exporting high-quality marble blocks to Europe and Southeast Asia.

As a growing and stable business, we are committed to precision workmanship, efficient production, and strong safety standards.

Position Overview

Due to continued operational growth, we are seeking a qualified and experienced Stonemason to join our team on a full-time FIFO basis to Onslow, WA.

This role focuses on marble block extraction, cutting, shaping, surface finishing, engraving, and structural stone installation, as well as supporting workshop coordination and equipment maintenance.

Key responsibilities:

- Design and plan phases of stone block cutting, slab polishing, and carving graphics, emphasizing precision and quality.

- Utilize both machinery and hand tools to cut, shape, and polish stones and bricks to fit specific spaces.

- Arrange stone blocks in rows, patterns, and configurations, using mortar to create desired structures while ensuring precise vertical and horizontal alignment, removing excess mortar to maintain structural integrity.

- Perform repairs and maintenance on bricks, cement blocks, and related structures.

- Manage, repair, and maintain stone production equipment, including wire saw machines, rock drilling machines, engraving machines, and related hand tools, ensuring they are in optimal working condition.

- Coordinate and develop production plans for the workshop, ensuring the efficient extraction and processing of stone blocks to meet final production targets for tiles, slabs, and flagstone.

- Ensure and enforce strict safety measures to ensure employees well-being during stone extraction and processing.

- Supervise and ensure that employees adhere to standardized equipment operation procedures.

- Provide comprehensive training and guidance to employees in the required stonemasonry skills, including stone block mining, special-shaped processing, polishing, and engraving.

Requirements:

- Proven experience working with marble or natural stone

- Knowledge of stone fabrication and installation techniques

- Ability to read drawings and use measuring tools accurately

- Good physical condition and ability to lift heavy materials

- Attention to detail and quality workmanship

- Team player with good communication skills

Preferred Qualifications:

- Certificate in Stonemasonry or equivalent qualification in stonemasonry or stone fabrication.

- Valid driver’s license.

Employment Conditions:

-Full-time position.

- FIFO roster to Onslow, Western Australia.

- Annual salary between AUD $90,000 – $120,000 plus superannuation.

- Salary determined based on qualifications and experience.

- Long-term opportunity within a growing export-focused company.

Job Type: Full-time

Alba Italian Restaurant is seeking an experienced full-time Waiter to join our front-of-house team in Newtown.
Alba is an independently operated Italian restaurant specialising in the food and hospitality of Southern Italy. We are looking for a professional hospitality employee who can provide knowledgeable, attentive and welcoming table service.

About the role
The Waiter will provide full table service, assist guests with menu and beverage selections and work closely with the kitchen and front-of-house team to deliver a consistent dining experience.
The position requires availability across a rotating roster, including evenings, weekends and public holidays.

Main responsibilities
Welcome guests and provide professional table service.
Explain menu items, ingredients, monthly specials and dietary options.
Take accurate food and beverage orders.
Enter orders correctly into the point-of-sale system.
Serve food, wine and other beverages in accordance with restaurant standards.
Provide appropriate food and wine recommendations.
Monitor tables throughout the dining experience.
Communicate guest requests and dietary requirements clearly to the kitchen.
Process bills and customer payments accurately.
Set up and reset the dining room before, during and after service.
Maintain clean and organised dining and service areas.
Assist with stock handling and basic beverage preparation.
Respond professionally to guest questions, requests and complaints.
Comply with responsible service of alcohol, food safety, and workplace health and safety requirements. 
Skills and experience

Applicants should have:
At least 2 years of relevant restaurant service experience.
Experience providing full table service in a busy restaurant.
Strong knowledge of food, wine and beverage service.
Excellent communication and customer-service skills.
The ability to carry multiple plates and manage several tables efficiently.
Strong attention to detail and order accuracy.
The ability to work calmly and professionally during busy services.
